returns.burnedShares: Shares burned (may be capped to total shares if closing position).

balanceOf(address).notice: Returns current outstanding debt of account (with accrued interest).

burn(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Burn debt shares from `borrower`. Called on repay().

mint(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Mint debt shares to `borrower`. Called on borrow().

documentation.text: @notice Returns current outstanding debt of account (with accrued interest).

@title DebtToken
 @notice Non-transferable ERC-20 tracking borrow shares per user.
         Minted on borrow(), burned on repay().
         transfer() and transferFrom() always revert — debt cannot be delegated.
         Rebasing via borrow index:
           underlying debt = debtShares * borrowIndex / RAY
         Arc note: debt for USDC uses the ERC-20 interface at 6 decimals.
